```yaml
name: Approve Workflows for First-Time Contributors

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [labeled, synchronize]
    branches:
      - main
      - 'release-**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  approve:
    name: Approve Workflows
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      actions: write
      pull-requests: read
    steps:
      - name: Check if contributor is first-time
        id: check-contributor
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          # Get the author of the PR
          PR_AUTHOR=$(gh pr view "$PR_NUMBER" --json author --jq '.author.login')
          
          # Count the number of PRs by this author in the repository
          # We use the GitHub API to search for PRs by this user
          # Note: This counts all PRs, including closed ones. 
          # A more robust check might look at merged PRs or specific timeframes, 
          # but for "first-time" usually means "has this user contributed before?"
          # The prompt says "≤1 PR (current only)", implying if they have 0 other PRs, they are first time.
          # So if count > 1 (including current), they are returning.
          
          PR_COUNT=$(gh api repos/"$REPO"/pulls \
            --jq "length" \
            --method GET \
            --header "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
            --query "state=all&per_page=100&author=$PR_AUTHOR" 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
          
          # If the count is greater than 1, they are a returning contributor
          if [ "$PR_COUNT" -gt 1 ]; then
            echo "is_first_time=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "is_first_time=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Check for ok-to-test label
        id: check-label
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          # Check if the PR has the 'ok-to-test' label
          HAS_LABEL=$(gh pr view "$PR_NUMBER" --json labels --jq '.labels[] | select(.name == "ok-to-test") | .name')
          
          if [ -n "$HAS_LABEL" ]; then
            echo "has_ok_to_test=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "has_ok_to_test=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Approve pending workflows
        if: steps.check-contributor.outputs.is_first_time == 'false' || steps.check-label.outputs.has_ok_to_test == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        run: |
          # Get all pending workflow runs for this PR
          # We need to find workflow runs associated with this PR that are in 'pending' state
          
          echo "Checking for pending workflow runs..."
          
          # Fetch recent workflow runs
          # We limit to a reasonable number to avoid excessive API calls
          RUNS=$(gh api repos/"${{ github.repository }}"/actions/runs \
            --jq '.workflow_runs[] | select(.status == "pending") | {id: .id, pull_requests: .pull_requests}' \
            --method GET \
            --header "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
            --query "per_page=100" 2>/dev/null || echo "[]")
          
          # Filter runs that are associated with the current PR
          # The pull_requests field is an array of objects with 'number' field
          echo "$RUNS" | jq -c '.[]' | while read -r run; do
            RUN_ID=$(echo "$run" | jq -r '.id')
            PR_NUMS=$(echo "$run" | jq -r '.pull_requests[].number')
            
            # Check if this run is for the current PR
            if echo "$PR_NUMS" | grep -q "^${PR_NUMBER}$"; then
              echo "Approving workflow run $RUN_ID for PR $PR_NUMBER"
              gh api repos/"${{ github.repository }}"/actions/runs/$RUN_ID/approve \
                --method POST \
                --header "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
                --input '{"approved_by": "github-actions"}' 2>/dev/null || true
            fi
          done
```
